title: 第1758章 青楼打折第1757章 尝尝鲜
content_zh:
来自树城的意外，造成了一个严重的后果。
那就是女帝的身份，开始遭到金雕一族的怀疑。
云极暗暗皱眉，
如果让金雕一族得知了楚天心的真正身份，肯定不会轻易放手。
自己加上千玑夫人，未必救得走女帝。
毕竟这里是雷裂崖，雷翼金雕一族的老巢，在场的就有数位大妖一位妖王，外面肯定还有大妖栖息。
真正的龙潭虎穴！
天烁帝君的目光变得古怪起来，盯着楚天心道：
“我倒是想起来了，昨天抓走白狐之际，那古宝巨舟后面跟着大量兵将，行进的方向正是万妖谷，你，到底是什么人！”
楚天心听到了苍羽带来的消息，她知道情况不妙，犹豫着如何回答。
这时云极小幅度的摇了摇头，示意楚天心别说实话，否则就出不去了。
楚天心立刻会意，声音沙哑的道：
“我是离国公主，名叫宇文霓裳，离国被邪修占据多年，百姓苦不堪言，此番行军是借用仙唐兵马，帮离国复国。”
云极听罢松了口气。
女帝就是女帝，这番谎话编造得天衣无缝。
落魄的公主，本就不值钱，没人在乎，朝仙唐借兵这一点，更是稳妥之言。
毕竟大军出征肯定有军旗，天烁帝君有可能认出那是仙唐的大军，所以说借兵才对，若是说成离国兵马很容易穿帮。
天烁帝君的脸上现出恍然之色，撇了撇嘴，看模样果然没什么兴趣。
云极生怕夜长梦多，提议道：
“太晚了，萤萤自己在家容易害怕，我们也该走了。”

千玑夫人闻言点了点头，缓缓起身，就要带着楚天心与云极离开。
“等等！”
这时苍羽的神态变得古怪起来，盯着楚天心道：“你说你是离国长公主宇文霓裳？据我所知，离国长公主不是早死了么，前阵子的花船会还帮她翻案来着，其实是冤死的，怎么，你一个大活人难道是冤死鬼么。”
楚天心闻言一怔，云极也是大为意外，惊讶不已。
苍羽这家伙的消息，怎么如此灵通！
不仅一眼识破了楚天心的身份，居然还知道离国长公主已经冤案昭雪？
花船会刚刚结束还没到半月呢，怎么消息都传到万妖谷了？
“老舅，难道你去看过花船会？怎么知道如此多的消息，我都不知道还有打折这事儿。”云极问道。
“这算什么！仙唐皇城我熟得很！”苍羽得意起来，道：“花船会当然没去，一群人族元婴，我过去找死啊！不过当晚我的确在长安城，幸亏了花船会，老子省了好大一笔灵石！”
“怎么召开花船会，你却省钱呢？”云极愈发疑惑。
“外甥你是不知道啊，正是因为召开花船会，修士们都去看热闹了，当晚青楼生意不好，打折！”苍羽眉开眼笑的道。
云极听完眼皮直跳，合着我没冤枉你啊！
就算不吃那个蛋炒饭，孵出来的指不定是什么鸟呢……
云极都服了，
随便攀亲戚认个老舅，居然也是同道中人，你丫可真花花，咱们看来是真亲戚，以后去青楼听曲儿有伴儿了。
“大妖都能混进皇城，怎么做到的呢？”云极疑惑道。
content_en:
The accident from Shucheng had a serious consequence.
That was the identity of the empress, which began to be suspected by the Golden Eagle clan.
Yunji frowned secretly,
If the Golden Eagle clan learns Chu Tianxin's true identity, they will definitely not let go easily.
Together with Mrs. Qianji, he may not be able to save the empress.
After all, this is Thunder Cliff, the home of the Thunder Winged Golden Eagle clan. There are several great demons and a demon king present, and there must be some great demons living outside.
The real dragon's pond and tiger's den!
Emperor Tianshuo's eyes became strange, and he stared at Chu Tian and said:
"I just remembered that when the white fox was captured yesterday, the ancient treasure boat was followed by a large number of soldiers. The direction it was traveling was the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons. Who are you!"
Chu Tianxin heard the news brought by Cang Yu. She knew the situation was not good and hesitated how to answer.
At this time, Yun Ji shook his head slightly, signaling Chu Tianxin not to tell the truth, otherwise he would not be able to get out.
Chu Tianxin immediately understood and said in a hoarse voice:
"I am the princess of Li Kingdom, and my name is Yu Wen Nichang. Li Kingdom has been occupied by evil cultivators for many years, and the people are suffering terribly. This march is to borrow the soldiers and horses of Xian Tang to help Li Kingdom recover."
Yunji breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this.
The empress is the empress, and this lie was fabricated perfectly.
The down-and-out princess was worthless and no one cared about it. Borrowing troops from the Immortal Tang Dynasty was even more safe.
After all, the army must have military flags when it goes out. Emperor Tianshuo may recognize that it is the army of Xian Tang, so it is only right to borrow troops. If it is said that they are soldiers from the Li Kingdom, it will be easy to get involved.
Emperor Tianshuo had a look of surprise on his face, curled his lips, and looked like he was not interested.
Yunji was afraid of long nights and many dreams, so he suggested:
"It's too late. Yingying gets scared easily at home. It's time for us to leave."
Upon hearing this, Mrs. Qianji nodded, slowly stood up, and was about to leave with Chu Tianxin and Yunji.
"Wait!"
At this time, Cang Yu's expression became weird, and he stared at Chu Tian and said in his mind: "You said you are the eldest princess of Li Kingdom, Yu Wen Nichang? As far as I know, the eldest princess of Li Kingdom died long ago, and the Flower Boat Festival a while ago helped her reverse the case. In fact, she died unjustly. Why, you, a living person, are you an unjust ghost?"
Chu Tianxin was startled when he heard this, and Yunji was also greatly surprised and surprised.
How come Cang Yu is so well informed!
Not only did he see through Chu Tianxin’s identity at a glance, but he also knew that Princess Li’s unjust case had been vindicated?
The Flower Boat Festival has just ended and it’s not even half a month yet. How come the news has reached the Ten Thousand Demons Valley?
"Uncle, have you ever been to the Flower Boat Festival? How do you know so much news? I didn't even know there was a discount." Yunji asked.
"What's this! I'm very familiar with the Immortal Tang Imperial City!" Cang Yu became proud and said: "Of course I didn't go to the Flower Boat Festival. A group of human Nascent Souls, I went there to seek death! But I was indeed in Chang'an City that night. Thanks to the Flower Boat Party, I saved a lot of spiritual stones!"
"How come you save money by holding a flower boat party?" Yunji became increasingly confused.
"Nephew, you don't know. It was because of the flower boat party that all the monks went to watch the fun. The business at the brothel was not good that night, so there was a discount!" Cang Yu said with a smile.
Yunji's eyelids jumped after hearing this, "I didn't accuse you wrongly!"
Even if you don’t eat the egg fried rice, you may not know what kind of bird it hatches...
Yunji is convinced,
Just ask a relative to recognize an old uncle, and he turns out to be a member of the same profession. You are such a flower. It seems that we are real relatives. From now on, we will have company when we go to the brothel to listen to music.
"A big demon can sneak into the imperial city, how can he do it?" Yunji asked in confusion.
